episodes.210833: Convective showers evolved into a squall line in advance of a strong cold front passage through the Florida Keys coastal waters.  Isolated gale-force wind gusts occurred in association with the convective showers.

events.county: Gulf Of America From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To Halfmoon Shoal Out To 5 Fathoms
events.narrative: A wind gust of 36 knots was measured at the National Ocean Service station at the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary Nancy Foster Center in association with a convective rain shower in advance of a cold front.

events.county: Hawk Channel From Ocean Reef To Craig Key Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A west-northwest wind gust of 34 knots was measured at a WeatherFlow station at Carysfort Reef Light in association with a convective rain shower in advance of a cold front.

events.county: Hawk Channel From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To Halfmoon Shoal Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A wind gust of 45 knots was measured at a Citizen Weather Observing Program station at the south end of Cudjoe Bay in association with a line of convective showers along a cold front.
